page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes in small type in the right margin, beside the first paragraph. Running head at the top. Page number at the top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.l: tam in hoc quam in illo objecto. Suppono solem
omnes flores in horto æqualiter luce &
calore suo imbuere, hic flos vegetat aliis a-
refcentibus, num recte dicerem floris vegetanti?
o tu reliquis beatior, plus debes soli,
quam reliqui. Sic enim subinnuerem, solem
reliquos flores luce & calore non illustrare,
hunc vero tantum beare, quod patet esse fal-
sum.
R. I. Suarez ait: non expedit de suis gloriari.
Valentia, gloriari (inquit) potest (converfus)

l.i: non in Domino solo, sed tum in Domino, tum

l.i: non gloriari ob periculum superbiæ & inanis

contr. Tilen. c. 5. p. 136. hominem tam se fe-
parare dici posse, quam ait scriptura, ho-

30. & 31. Sed quæritur an liceat gloriari in eo
quod recepimus, quasi non recepissemus.

ri in actu libero suæ converfionis activæ,
quam a Deo non magis habet, quam non-

cum

page.notes: Running head "GRATIÆ." is set in spaced capitals. Page number read as 441 from a worn "44¹" at the top right; the final digit is doubtful. "ut o&o" is unclear and may be "ut octo"; marked [?]. Marginal references at the right are very small and partly cut; their line breaks and exact positions are approximate. Greek and Latin reference numbers as printed. The catchword "cum" and signature "Ee 5" are at the foot. Hyphenated line-end words ("fi-cut", "gloria-ri", "fe-parare", "non-converfus", "ve-lint") were joined, with the printed hyphen kept only where the word is a compound ("non-converfus").
